description: This file provides database connection configuration and utility functions for executing SQL queries against a MySQL database using the PyMySQL library. It defines a dataclass for configuration, functions to parse database URLs, load environment variables, and perform fetch and execute operations.

classes.name: DBConfig
classes.description: Immutable data class representing the database connection configuration, including host, port, user, password, and database name.

methods.name: Tuple[str,int,str] _parse_mysql_url(mysql_url: str)
methods.description: Parses a MySQL connection URL of the form 'mysql://host:port/db' into its components.

methods.name: DBConfig load_db_config()
methods.description: Loads database configuration from environment variables, supporting URL parsing and environment overrides.

methods.name: pymysql.connections.Connection _connect(cfg: DBConfig)
methods.description: Establishes and returns a PyMySQL connection using the provided configuration.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _rows_to_list(rows: Sequence[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Converts sequence of database row dictionaries into a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_all(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None)
methods.description: Executes a query and returns all resulting rows as a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_one(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None)
methods.description: Executes a query and returns a single row as a dictionary, or None if no result.

methods.name: int execute(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None)
methods.description: Executes a statement and returns the number of affected rows.

methods.name: int execute_many(query: str, params_seq: Sequence[Sequence[Any]])
methods.description: Executes many parameterized statements and returns total affected rows.

ctags.name: execute
ctags.pattern: /^def execute(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None) -> int:$/

ctags.name: fetch_all
ctags.pattern: /^def fetch_all(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: fetch_one
ctags.pattern: /^def fetch_one(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
